question: The strength of the sanctioned judges of the Supreme Court (SC) of India, including the Chief Justice, is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**34**__.

**__Key Points__**

• The current sanctioned strength of the **Supreme Court of India** is **34** judges. This figure includes the **Chief Justice of India (CJI)** and **33 other judges**.

• The strength was last increased in **September 2019**. Before this amendment, the sanctioned strength was **31** (including the **CJI**). The **Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Act, 2019**, was enacted to increase the number of judges to handle the increasing workload and reduce the pendency of cases in the apex court.

• According to **Article 124** of the **Constitution of India**, the **Parliament** has the exclusive power to prescribe the number of judges in the **Supreme Court**. The **Constitution** originally provided for a **Chief Justice** and **7** other judges in **1950**, but allowed **Parliament** to increase this number by law.
